summary: Union Parish, Louisiana steel lookout about 115 feet high, first observed by the federal survey in 1952; marked removed, with no site description found.

facts.status_note: Marked removed by the lookouts site; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Height 35.1 m in the record matches the about-115-ft description. The two sources give different USGS quad editions (lookouts page 1985, NGS sheet 2018); not a record error. The NGS station position is about 17 m east of the record point; left unchanged. The removal status rests on the lookouts page alone, with no date. No build date, staffing or fire history found; no photos found.
